_comment: Editorial decisions the engine cannot make for the book, applied by
scripts/extract-book-data.mjs on top of what it reads from the CDN, so a
re-extract after a Noisemaker release keeps them.
exclude: effects that have no page. Each one needs a reason.
programs: effects whose engine-derived default program does not actually
demonstrate the effect on a book page. Each one needs a reason too, and
the program still has to call the effect it belongs to, which the offline

exclude.synth/media: needs a file, a camera or a screen share to show anything; a book page has none of them
exclude.synth/remap: the default program wires no zones, so the page would show a background colour and nothing else
exclude.synth/roll: needs a MIDI keyboard attached and someone playing it
exclude.synth/scope: needs microphone access, which a reader turning pages should not be asked for
exclude.synth/spectrum: needs microphone access, which a reader turning pages should not be asked for
exclude.render/meshLoader: loads geometry into textures and draws nothing on its own
exclude.render/meshRender: the mesh path is a proof of concept and paints one flat tone here

filter/blur.why: a blur needs a hard edge to soften, and the derived program blurs a noise field that has none
filter/blur.program:
search filter, synth

testPattern(pattern: checkerboard, gridSize: 8)
  .blur(radiusX: 18, radiusY: 18)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

filter/bulge.why: wrap only decides what fills the frame where the bulge reaches past its edge, and an unrotated bulge never does, so the derived program left all three wrap modes looking the same

filter/feedback.why: feedback only shows when something is fed back and moved, so the loop needs a mix, a blend mode and a transform
filter/feedback.program:
search filter, synth

noise(seed: 1, ridges: true)
  .feedback(mix: 49, blendMode: lighten, scaleAmt: 102, rotation: 3, intensity: -25)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

filter/fibers.why: threads have to lie on something; the derived program lays them on a flat black fill
filter/fibers.program:
search filter, synth

noise(seed: 5, octaves: 4, ridges: true, colorMode: rgb, speed: 0)
  .grade(preset: sepia)
  .fibers(density: 0.8, alpha: 0.7, seed: 2)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

filter/grade.why: every stage sits at neutral by default, so the derived program grades nothing; a named preset shows the suite doing its job
filter/grade.program:
search filter, synth

noise(seed: 1, ridges: true)
  .grade(preset: tealOrange)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

filter/grime.why: dirt has to settle on something; the derived program lays it on a flat white fill
filter/grime.program:
search filter, synth

noise(seed: 5, octaves: 4, ridges: true, colorMode: rgb, speed: 0)
  .grade(preset: sepia)
  .grime(strength: 1, seed: 4)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

filter/median.why: removing speckles is invisible unless there are speckles and something to compare against, so the page adds static and splits the frame: cleaned on the left, untouched on the right
filter/median.program:
search filter, mixer, synth

perlin(scale: 85, octaves: 4, colorMode: rgb, speed: 0)
  .snow(alpha: 1, density: 8, pause: true)
  .write(o0)

read(o0)
  .median(radius: 3)
  .split(tex: read(o0), rotation: 90)
  .write(o1)

render(o1)

filter/motionBlur.why: a trail needs movement, and the derived program blurs a still frame
filter/motionBlur.program:
search filter, synth

testPattern(pattern: colorBars)
  .scroll(speedX: 3, speedY: 0)
  .motionBlur(amount: 92)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

filter/normalize.why: auto levels does nothing to a picture that already fills the range, and nothing visible at all without the flat original beside it: washed out on the right, stretched on the left
filter/normalize.program:
search filter, mixer, synth

perlin(scale: 55, octaves: 3, colorMode: rgb, speed: 0)
  .adjust(contrast: 0.08, brightness: 1.5)
  .write(o0)

read(o0)
  .normalize()
  .split(tex: read(o0), rotation: 90)
  .write(o1)

render(o1)

filter/osd.why: the readout defaults to the bottom right, where the book's own writing sits over it; the nudge moves it clear of the toolbar as well
filter/osd.program:
search filter, synth

noise(seed: 1, ridges: true)
  .osd(corner: topRight, alpha: 1, speed: 6, seed: 7)
  .translate(y: -0.1, wrap: clamp)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

filter/outline.why: operator's program: constant-interpolated noise gives the flat regions an outline can actually trace, where the smooth default has no boundaries to ink
filter/outline.program:
search filter, synth

noise(
  type: constant,
  ridges: true,
  loopScale: 100
)
  .outline(thickness: 2.7)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

filter/pixelSort.why: wrap only shows where an angled sort reads past the frame's edge, and the derived program sorts straight along the rows
filter/pixelSort.program:
search filter, synth

noise(seed: 1, ridges: true)
  .pixelSort(angled: 45)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

filter/pondRipples.why: a ripple bends straight lines, and there are none in a noise field to bend
filter/pondRipples.program:
search filter, synth

testPattern(pattern: gridLines, gridSize: 10)
  .pondRipples(amount: 70, ridges: 14, speed: 2)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

filter/scratches.why: scratches belong on a picture; the derived program puts them on a flat grey fill
filter/scratches.program:
search filter, synth

noise(seed: 5, octaves: 4, ridges: true, colorMode: rgb, speed: 0)
  .grade(preset: sepia)
  .scratches(density: 0.7, alpha: 0.9, seed: 3)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

filter/tetraColorArray.why: color mode is the space the colours are blended in, and the derived program turns blending off with smoothness 0, so every color mode looked the same

filter/texture.why: a surface texture reads as a surface only when there is a picture printed on it, not a flat fill
filter/texture.program:
search filter, synth

noise(seed: 5, octaves: 4, ridges: true, colorMode: rgb, speed: 0)
  .grade(preset: sepia)
  .texture(mode: canvas, alpha: 0.9, scale: 1.6, intensity: 70)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

mixer/shadow.why: the derived program casts the shadow from a mono image, where red, green and blue are the same channel, so the source channel choice changed nothing
mixer/shadow.program:
search mixer, synth

noise(scaleX: 100, scaleY: 100)
  .write(o0)

noise(ridges: true, colorMode: mono)
  .shadow(tex: read(o0), maskSource: sourceB)
  .write(o1)

render(o1)

mixer/uvRemap.why: the derived program remaps a pattern that only varies along one axis, with coordinates that never leave the frame, so neither the channel pair nor the wrap mode changed anything
mixer/uvRemap.program:
search mixer, synth

noise(seed: 7, scaleX: 30, scaleY: 30)
  .write(o0)

noise(colorMode: rgb)
  .uvRemap(tex: read(o0), scale: 200, offset: 0.5)
  .write(o1)

render(o1)

points/attractor.why: pointsRender viewMode was emitted as raw integer 1 instead of the enum choice ortho matching the prose
points/attractor.program:
search points, synth, render

noise()
  .pointsEmit()
  .attractor()
  .pointsRender(viewMode: ortho)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

points/buddhabrot.why: upstream defaultProgram passed numeric 512 instead of enum choice x512 to pointsEmit
points/buddhabrot.program:
search points, synth, render

perlin()
  .pointsEmit(stateSize: x512)
  .buddhabrot()
  .pointsRender(intensity: 99)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

render/renderCubemap3d.why: the derived program ends the chain in render3d(), which redraws the volume and discards the cube map this effect draws, so the page showed render3d() and none of its controls did anything
render/renderCubemap3d.program:
search synth3d, render

noise3d(volumeSize: x64)
  .renderCubemap3d()
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

render/renderCubemapSurface.why: the derived program ends the chain in render3d(), which redraws the volume and discards the cube map this effect draws, so the page showed render3d() instead
render/renderCubemapSurface.program:
search synth3d, render

noise3d(volumeSize: x64)
  .renderCubemapSurface()
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

synth/cellularAutomata.why: the input texture only seeds the automaton in proportion to its weight, and the derived program leaves the weight at 0, so choosing a texture changed nothing
synth/cellularAutomata.program:
search synth

noise(seed: 1, ridges: true)
  .write(o0)

cellularAutomata(tex: read(o0), weight: 50)
  .write(o1)

render(o1)

synth/mandala.why: the spiral wave animation swings the twist, and the derived program has no twist to swing

synth/mnca.why: the input texture only seeds the automaton in proportion to its weight, and the derived program leaves the weight at 0, so choosing a texture changed nothing
synth/mnca.program:
search synth

noise(seed: 1, ridges: true)
  .write(o0)

mnca(tex: read(o0), weight: 50)
  .write(o1)

render(o1)

synth/navierStokes.why: smoothing filters the upscale from a zoomed simulation, and at the derived program's zoom of x1 there is no upscale to smooth
synth/navierStokes.program:
search synth

noise(
  type: hermite,
  ridges: true,
  speed: 30,
  colorMode: mono
)
  .write(o0)

navierStokes(
  tex: read(o0),
  zoom: x2,
  dyeDecay: 98,
  inputForce: 0.5,
  inputIntensity: 10
)
  .write(o1)

render(o1)

synth/reactionDiffusion.why: the input texture only steers the reaction through a source that reads it, in proportion to its weight; the derived program reads no texture and leaves the weight at 0, so choosing a texture or a source changed nothing
synth/reactionDiffusion.program:
search synth

noise(seed: 1, ridges: true)
  .write(o0)

reactionDiffusion(tex: read(o0), sourceF: sliderInput, weight: 50)
  .write(o1)

render(o1)

synth/subdivide.why: the input texture only shows through in proportion to inputMix, and the derived program leaves it at 0; wrap only shows where a cell's shape differs from the frame's, which needs binary splits
synth/subdivide.program:
search synth

noise(seed: 1, ridges: true)
  .write(o0)

subdivide(tex: read(o0), mode: binary, inputMix: 50)
  .write(o1)

render(o1)

synth3d/cellularAutomata3d.why: the derived program gives the automaton no source volume and a weight of 0, so choosing a source volume or geometry changed nothing
synth3d/cellularAutomata3d.program:
search synth3d, render

noise3d(volumeSize: x32)
  .write3d(vol0, geo0)

cellularAutomata3d(ruleIndex: diamoeba, source: read3d(vol0), geoSource: read3d(geo0), weight: 50)
  .render3d()
  .write(o0)

render(o0)

synth3d/reactionDiffusion3d.why: the source volume only steers the reaction in proportion to its weight, and the derived program leaves the weight at 0, so choosing a source volume or geometry changed nothing
synth3d/reactionDiffusion3d.program:
search synth3d, render

noise3d(volumeSize: x32)
  .write3d(vol0, geo0)

reactionDiffusion3d(source: read3d(vol0), geoSource: read3d(geo0), weight: 50)
  .render3d()
  .write(o0)

render(o0)
